dashboard.label: ZTA - Zero Trust Security Command Center
dashboard.description: Threat Monitoring, User Behavior Analytics, and Performance SLA dashboard for the Zero Trust Architecture

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | timechart span=10m count by decision | sort _time

panel.title: Metodi di Autenticazione Dispositivo (TPM vs. Software)

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | eval device_type = if(device="no-tpm" OR device="unknown", "Software Cert (No TPM / High Risk)", "Hardware-Bound (TPM / Low Risk)") | stats count by device_type

chart.option: {"Hardware-Bound (TPM / Low Risk)": 0x137333, "Software Cert (No TPM / High Risk)": 0xe67c73}

panel.title: Distribuzione delle Categorie di Blocco OPA/WAF

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" decision="DENY" | eval reason = case( block_reason == "OIDC_TOKEN_INVALID", "Token OIDC Invalido o Scaduto", block_reason == "RISK_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED", "Soglia Rischio Adattiva Superata", block_reason == "INVALID_ACTION", "Azione DB Non Valida", block_reason == "RBAC_DENIED", "RBAC Negato", block_reason == "STEP_UP_REQUIRED", "Biometria Step-Up Richiesta", block_reason == "STEP_UP_STALE", "Biometria Scaduta", block_reason == "UNAUTHENTICATED", "Utente Non Autenticato", block_reason == "ROLE_SEGREGATION_DENIED", "Violazione Separazione Compiti", block_reason == "INSPECTION_VIOLATION", "Violazione Content WAF L7", block_reason == "WAF_BLOCKED", "Bloccato da WAF Envoy (Lua)", 1=1, coalesce(block_reason, "Politica Generica") ) | stats count by reason

panel.title: Allarmi NIDS Snort: PEP vs. Risorsa

search.query: index=zta_snort sourcetype="snort:alert_json" | eval sensor_type = if(sensor=="pep", "Perimetro (PEP)", "Risorsa (DB)") | stats count by sensor_type, msg

index=zta_nftables sourcetype="nftables:log" action="DROP" | bin _time span=1m | stats count as drops by src_ip, _time | where drops > 15 | stats sum(drops) as total_drops, count(eval(drops > 15)) as active_scanning_minutes by src_ip | rename src_ip as "IP Attaccante", total_drops as "Pacchetti Droppati", active_scanning_minutes as "Minuti di Scansione Rilevati" | sort - "Pacchetti Droppati"

panel.title: Tentativi Brute Force / Login Falliti su MongoDB

search.query: index=zta_mongodb_audit sourcetype="mongodb:audit" result!=0 (atype="authenticate" OR "auth") | stats count as fallimenti, values(users{}.user) as utenti_tentati, values(param.user) as utenti_param by ip | eval utenti = coalesce(utenti_tentati, utenti_param) | where fallimenti >= 3 | rename ip as "IP Sorgente", fallimenti as "Tentativi Falliti", utenti as "Username Tentati" | sort - "Tentativi Falliti"

html.h2: 3. User & Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) & Dynamic Risk

panel.title: UBA: Rilevamento anomalie nel Volume delle Query (Z-Score > 2.0)

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | bucket _time span=15m | stats count as query_count by user, _time | eventstats avg(query_count) as media, stdev(query_count) as dev_std by user | where _time >= now() - 1800 | eval z_score = if(dev_std > 0, (query_count - media) / dev_std, 0) | where z_score > 2.0 | eval z_score = round(z_score, 2), media = round(media, 1), dev_std = round(dev_std, 1) | rename user as "Utente", query_count as "Query Correnti (15m)", media as "Media Storica", dev_std as "Deviazione Standard", z_score as "Z-Score (Anomalia)" | table "Utente" "Query Correnti (15m)" "Media Storica" "Deviazione Standard" "Z-Score (Anomalia)" | sort - "Z-Score (Anomalia)"

panel.title: Top Entità ad Alto Rischio (Utente x IP x Max Risk Score)

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | eval risk_num = tonumber(risk_score) | stats max(risk_num) as max_risk, avg(risk_num) as avg_risk, count(eval(decision="DENY")) as total_denies, values(device) as devices by user, source_address | eval avg_risk = round(avg_risk, 1) | rename user as "Utente", source_address as "IP Chiamante", max_risk as "Risk Score Max", avg_risk as "Risk Score Medio", total_denies as "Totale Dinieghi", devices as "Dispositivo" | sort - "Risk Score Max" | head 15

panel.title: Latenza di Valutazione delle Policy OPA (Nanosecondi -> Millisecondi)

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | eval eval_ms = tonumber(eval_ns) / 1000000 | timechart span=10m avg(eval_ms) as "Latenza Rego PDP (ms)" max(eval_ms) as "Latenza Picco Rego (ms)"

panel.title: Latenza di Rete e Proxy Envoy (Overhead PEP)

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="envoy:access" | eval duration_num = tonumber(duration_ms) | timechart span=10m avg(duration_num) as "Latenza Richiesta PEP (ms)" max(duration_num) as "Latenza Picco PEP (ms)"

panel.title: Ultimi 50 Eventi di Controllo Accessi OPA PDP

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="opa:decision" | eval device_type = if(device="no-tpm" OR device="unknown", "Software", "TPM Hardware") | table _time user role collection command decision risk_score device_type source_address block_reason | rename _time as "Data/Ora", user as "Utente", role as "Ruolo", collection as "Collezione", command as "Azione", decision as "Decisione", risk_score as "Rischio", device_type as "Sicurezza HW", source_address as "IP Client", block_reason as "Motivo Blocco" | head 50
